A hospital that feels like someone is looking out for you.

About Lumi Hospital

A multi-speciality hospital where senior specialists, modern diagnostics and genuinely kind people work as one team, around the clock.

Towards Healthy Life
(01)Our story

We started from one question: what would a hospital feel like if it were designed around the person in the waiting chair, not the queue?

The answer shaped everything. 10 specialities that share one record, so you never repeat your story. Diagnostics in the same building, so a scan doesn't become a second trip. An emergency team, ICU and pharmacy that never close.

And people who remember that a hospital visit is rarely a good day. Our specialists are senior, but they are also patient. They explain, they listen, and they treat your time as carefully as your health.

(02)What we stand for

Four principles, every shift.

These aren't slogans on a wall. They're the questions we ask at handover, in reviews and when something goes wrong.

01/ 04
  1. 01Listen
  2. 02Clarity
  3. 03Time
  4. 04Safety
  1. 01

    Listen before we treat

    The answer is usually in the story. Consultants take the history themselves and give you the time to tell it properly.

    • Senior doctors see you in person
    • Room for questions in every consult
    • Family welcome in the conversation
  2. 02

    Say it plainly

    A diagnosis you don't understand is only half a diagnosis. We explain what we found, what it means and what happens next, in your language.

    • Plain-language explanations
    • Written plans you can take home
    • Costs discussed before treatment
  3. 03

    Treat time as care

    Waiting is not neutral. Booked slots run to the clock, reports come to your phone, and records follow you between specialists.

    • Booked patients seen first
    • Shared records across specialities
    • Digital reports and reminders
  4. 04

    Never cut a corner

    Safety is a habit, not a poster. Checks at every handover, strict infection control and the humility to ask a colleague.

    • Checklists at every handover
    • Infection control on every floor
    • Second opinions encouraged
(03)Facilities

Everything you need, under one roof.

Critical care, surgery and diagnostics sit a corridor apart, so the right equipment and the right people reach you quickly.

01

Intensive care unit

Monitored beds with ventilator support and a critical-care team on duty around the clock.

24/7
02

Neonatal ICU

Close monitoring and specialist care for premature and unwell newborns.

03

Operation theatres

Modular theatres with twin surgical lights and anaesthesia workstations, for planned and emergency surgery.

04

Wards

Curtained bays with bedside oxygen and monitoring, and room for a family member to stay close.

05

Laboratory

An in-house lab for routine and urgent tests, so results arrive while decisions are being made.

24 hours

OPD & reception

Bright, glass-fronted consultation rooms and a reception that keeps your file ready before you arrive.
07

Emergency & ambulance

A separate emergency entrance with ramp access, and an ambulance on standby day and night.

Pharmacy

An in-house pharmacy at the entrance, so you leave with your medicines in hand.
